TD1 Builder is an unofficial fanmade website for creating and sharing The Division builds.
It's not a tool for theorycrafting as it lacks numbers and calculations.

## Contributing

If you are interested in contributing directly to this repository, please see:

- [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/Strappazzon/td1-builder/blob/-/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Strappazzon/.github/blob/-/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
